clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Kadrell sends you north from Loch Modan to join Rockgar at Dun Algaz. Rockgar is organizing an expedition into the sodden lowlands of the Wetlands, along the pass between the dwarven homeland and the northern territories.

Dun Algaz cuts through the northern ridge, linking Loch Modan with the marshy Wetlands. The fortified pass carries trade, messengers, and military detachments between Ironforge and Alliance settlements farther north. With tensions rising along the borders, Mountaineer Kadrell watches travelers on the road and recruits hardy volunteers for the northern outposts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.
If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz. Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, adventurer! You're here for the scouting mission, are you? Very good!
I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
